invariants.title: The cause is on screen
invariants.rule: The strap snaps taut and the tower begins to tilt IN this shot.
invariants.why: Without the cause the fall in 070 is luck, not her doing.

invariants.title: It is her weight
invariants.rule: She pulls with her whole body, leaning back.
invariants.why: It is a courier's strength, not a hero's.

invariants.title: It is LTX
invariants.rule: The take in the film is LTX-2.5's.
invariants.why: The groan of the wood comes with LTX's sound.

title: the strap
beat: Nadia throws her weight back on the strap; it snaps taut and the tower of crates above her starts to tilt.

build.script: LTX-2.5 (70) from a Qwen-Image-2.1 start frame (qwen21_s202) · take 11
